build_swin_transformer_backbone: build a SwinTransformer backbone with tiny architecture for image feature extraction on 224x224 inputs
create_swin_block: create a SwinBlock with shifted window self-attention and feedforward network for transformer layers
create_swin_block_sequence: create a SwinBlockSequence with multiple SwinBlocks and optional PatchMerging downsampling layer
test_swin_transformer_forward: test the SwinTransformer forward pass by passing a random tensor and verifying multi-scale output shapes
review_swin_transformer_arch_zoo: review the SwinTransformer arch_zoo to compare tiny small base and large architecture configurations
